# inspection-plan sampling table and receipt lot

Case: CASE-051
Document control number: SPEC-0051
Effective revision: R3
Superseded revision visible in archive: R8
Subject: plated busbar receipt
Primary measure: received busbars under the inspection plan
Source finished or header quantity: 111
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: sample quantity required by lot size and severity
Exclusion definition: units outside the lot or already inspected
Control: effective plan, lot, supplier, characteristic, and sample-size table

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000051, organization SEA, and CASE-051. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from lab inspection capacity; external timing is conditional on certificate and plating-bath report. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
